I managed to get FISP coupons this year, so I will apply both NPK and urea on my main maize plot, though I need to share the inputs across my other land too. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the subsidy and rely on family labor for most of the ridging, planting, and weeding, but I will likely hire a few days of ganyu when the weeds are heavy after the rains. I do not see the need to waste money on chemicals or irrigation for maize since the rains should be enough and pests are rarely a problem for us here in Ntchisi.
